I also thank my hon. Friend the Member for Brent Central for raising the issue of racism within the NHS. It is of course unacceptable that any person should experience racism in the NHS. As we know, people from black, Asian and minority ethnic backgrounds make up a disproportionate number of NHS staff. It is therefore unacceptable that they should be subjected to any form of racial abuse or violence.
The NHS is one of our most powerful institutions, but it is not immune to the same deep-rooted inequalities that exist in society as a whole. Black and Asian staff are more likely than their white colleagues to work in the most stretched and dangerous frontline roles, often without access to the right personal protective equipment.
